paragraphs: Sternberg supplies decorative outdoor luminaires, poles and smart city solutions, and traces its founding to 1923. Its specification grade products are described as featured design elements in downtowns, parks, campuses, roadways and retail centers across North America. Precision optics, LEDs and controls are integrated to address environmental sustainability and energy conservation.

The about page says Sternberg serves the Municipal, Utility, DOT and Commercial markets. The home page directs visitors to find the official Sternberg representative for their area. Sternberg introduced its first commercial cast aluminium poles and lighting fixtures in the 1940s. Sternberg was acquired by LMPG in 2018, and LMPG is based in Montreal.
